```{r setup}
library(ghg.sp)
library(tidyverse)
ggplot2::theme_set( councilR::council_theme(use_showtext = TRUE))

```


```{r}
bau_summary <- scenario_results(pass_tb = transportation_data$passenger %>% 
                                  filter(ctu %in% c("St. Paul",
                                                    "All")),
                                freight_tb = transportation_data$freight %>% 
                                  filter(ctu %in% c("St. Paul",
                                                    "All")),
                                .scenario = "BAU",
                                .electric_scenario = "ER",
                                .aeo_scenario = "REF")

```
```{r}
bind_rows(bau_summary$passenger$PLDV$vmt,
          bau_summary$passenger$RAIL$vmt,
          bau_summary$passenger$BU_BRT$vmt,
          bau_summary$passenger$WALK_BIKE$vmt,
          bau_summary$passenger$BS$vmt,
          bau_summary$passenger$AV$vmt) %>% 
  select(-stock, -aeo_mode) %>% 
  group_by(ctu, year, mode) %>% 
  summarize(total_vmt = sum(vmt, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = total_vmt,
             # color = mode,
             fill = reorder(mode,-total_vmt),
             group = reorder(mode, -total_vmt))) +
  geom_area()
```

```{r}
bau_summary$passenger$PLDV$dir_ghg %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = dir_ghg,
             fill = class,
             color = class,
             group = class)) +
  geom_area()
```


```{r}
bind_rows(bau_summary$passenger$PLDV$dir_ghg,
          bau_summary$passenger$RAIL$dir_ghg,
          bau_summary$passenger$BU_BRT$dir_ghg,
          bau_summary$passenger$WALK_BIKE$dir_ghg,
          bau_summary$passenger$BS$dir_ghg,
          bau_summary$passenger$AV$dir_ghg) %>% 
  select(-aeo_mode) %>% 
  group_by(ctu, year, mode) %>% 
  summarize(total_dir_ghg = sum(dir_ghg, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = total_dir_ghg,
             # color = mode,
             fill = mode,
             group = mode)) +
  geom_area()
```


## Interventions  

### Vehicle electrification  

```{r}
mitigation_ev <- scenario_results(
  pass_tb = transportation_data$passenger %>% 
                                  filter(ctu %in% c("St. Paul",
                                                    "All")),
                                freight_tb = transportation_data$freight %>% 
                                  filter(ctu %in% c("St. Paul",
                                                    "All")),
  .scenario = "MIT-EV",
  .electric_scenario = "ER",
  .aeo_scenario = "REF", 
  .bev_pct_sales = 0.25,
  .hev_pct_sales = 0.25,
  .phev_pct_sales = 0.25
)

```

```{r}
mitigation_ev$passenger$PLDV$dir_ghg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = dir_ghg,
             fill = class,
             color = class,
             group = class)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack")
```

```{r}
alternate_scenario <- scenario_results(
  .scenario = "MIT",
  .electric_scenario = "ER",
  .aeo_scenario = "REF",
  .drs_fuel_type = "BEV",
  .av_pct = 5,
  .av_fuel_type = "BEV"
)
```

```{r}
bind_rows(
bau_summary$passenger$PLDV$vmt %>% 
  filter(ctu == "St. Paul"),

alternate_scenario$passenger$PLDV$vmt %>% 
  filter(ctu == "St. Paul")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = vmt,
             shape = class,
             color = scenario)) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_shape_discrete(labels = c("Battery electric",
                                 "Diesel",
                                 "Hybrid electric",
                                 "Plug-in Hybrid",
                                 "Gasoline"))

```

```{r}
bau_summary$passenger$BU_BRT$vmt %>% 
    filter(mode == "BU",
         ctu == "St. Paul",
         class == "BCI")  %>% 
      mutate(vmt = vmt / 10^5)


```
